sophia_research: Triage: seeing punctuation dropout in summarization evals after INT8 bringup for r3-small. Long 8k inputs — outputs losing periods/commas, breaking JSONL consumer. Anyone seen this? :eyes:
ryan_eng: Which quant config? layernorm folding enabled? which quant backend (gptq/awq)?
eva_qa: Repro and metrics: run on ci/evals v2.4.2, seed=42
- parse_fail_rate: baseline 0.2% -> int8-build 7.8%
- rougeL: -0.9
Example (input -> model output):
```
INPUT: [LONG DOC TRUNC]
OUTPUT (int8): {"summary": "This is a summary without punctuation it runs on and on"}
OUTPUT (fp32): {"summary": "This is a summary. It runs on and on."}
```
ciara_infra: Is this only on hosted dedicated pools or repros locally? any correlation with shared_kv_pool setting?
ryan_eng: Repro locally with our quant image:
```
./run_eval --model r3-small --quant int8 --fold-layernorm=true --context 8192 --batch 4 --seed 42
```
I see train logs with this warning then repeated casts:
```
WARN: folded_layernorm_scale underflow at layer 20
TRACE: quant_cast (float->int8) saturating values near 0 -> 0.0
```
sophia_research: Good catch. Eva, can you try with `--fold-layernorm=false` and `--batch 1`? Also test `--no-kv-cache` to isolate caching.
eva_qa: Ran that: disabling layernorm folding + batch 1 + no-kv-cache => parse_fail_rate back to 0.3% :white_check_mark:. fp32 still fine. So folding seems to trigger on long contexts.
ryan_eng: Hypothesis: layernorm folding combined with int8 softmax quantization leads to small negative rounding in logits producing punctuation token suppression. Quick fix: skip folding for layernorms when context>2048 or when softmax quant scale < 1e-3. I'll land a small guard.
ryan_eng: PR: https://github.com/redwood/r3/commit/abcdef0 (draft)
deploy-bot: Canary deploy for `r3-small/int8/no_lnfold` to canary pool started — id=cny-2026-03-18-7 — rolling 20% :rocket:
ciara_infra: Note: canary nodes are still on cudnn 8.2; put a task to test on onprem-gpu-1 (cudnn 8.4) to rule out library differences.
sophia_research: Next steps:
- run canary and monitor parse_fail_rate by dataset (news,summaries,legal)
- backfill evals for longform suite w/ and w/o folding
- if stable, promote to dedicated pools and add a guard in config for context length
- write a short note in eng-ml channel after canary results
Thanks all :pray:
